# HorneroOS

> HorneroOS is an Arch-based workstation for building, creating and playing, with a distinctive desktop experience and an integrated operating-system ecosystem: Desktop, Studio and Gaming editions, the horneroctl system tool and Hornero Shell. Hyprland is the supported default compositor and Niri is experimental. Its design language is Hornero Signal.

## Status

HorneroOS is pre-release. Desktop, Studio and Gaming Preview install from the signed v0.2.0-preview32 ISO (one x86_64 image, VM-validated; see https://www.horneroos.com/install). The Desktop is also available as Arch packages for existing Arch systems. Hornero Signal (hornero-shell 1.3.0, hornero-config 0.4.0, hornero-greeter 1.1.0, horneroctl-bin 0.2.0_preview46) shipped as the package-only release v0.2.0-preview33: it is not in the preview32 ISO, and installs get it by updating the AUR packages (for example `yay -Syu`). Server and Agents are defined as composable editions with planned maturity and no installable image.

The default language is Spanish (Argentina); English lives under /en/.

## Pages

- `/` — what Hornero OS is
- `/install` — download the signed ISO, verification and requirements
- `/editions` — Desktop, Studio and Gaming Preview; Server and Agents planned
- `/studio` — creative workflows and applications
- `/gaming` — gaming capabilities and tools
- `/releases` — Preview history and verification links
- `/themes` — the coordinated look catalogue and palette generation
- `/layouts` — bar, dock, island, and rail arrangements
- `/roots` — where each piece comes from
- `/showroom` — real desktop captures with provenance
- `/docs/` — the user and contributor handbook
